{{For|other characters named Troy|Troy}} {{Infobox character |name =Sheriff Troy |games =FOTV |image =Sheriff Troy.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Male |status =Deceased |family =[[Filly townsperson|Unnamed father]] |dob = |dod =[[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] |dod verified=yes |location = |role =[[Sheriff (TV series)|Sheriff]] |affiliation =[[Govermint|The Govermint]] |TV actor =[[Russell Ewing]] }} '''Sheriff Troy''' is a member of the [[Govermint]] {{In|FOTV}}.{{fotv|1|6}} ==Background== Troy works as a [[sheriff (TV series)|sheriff]] for [[Sorrel Booker]]'s "[[Govermint]]," along with [[Rex (TV series)|Sheriff Rex]]. [[Filly townsperson|His father]] lives in [[Filly]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== Troy and Rex find [[the Ghoul]] at the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]], together with the dead bodies of the organ harvesters. They assume he was responsible for the incident there and bring him to President Booker at the [[BBQ Shack (TV series)|BBQ Shack]]. [[File:Troy aiming at The Ghoul.png|thumb|250px|Troy aiming his gun at the Ghoul]] When the Ghoul mentions killing a number of people in Filly, which would include Troy's father, "unless he was a coward", Troy aims his gun at the prisoner. Eventually, the Ghoul kills both sheriffs. ==Personality== Troy was never afraid to flaunt his authority as sheriff of the govermint; however, he's shown to have deeply cared about his father, who the Ghoul may have killed during his shoot-out in Filly. ==Inventory== {{Inventory |game =FOTV |apparel =[[Sheriff uniform]]
